findings.statement: 6x3-k4 has no V or D winning lines and zero HVD OOO triples, yet its non-HVD residue has rank 16 and preserves the complete two-dimensional scalar dependency image.
HVD-only OOO residue is scalar-exact on 6x3-k3 but scalar-inexact on 4x5-k4 and vacuous on 6x3-k4; no common HVD-only law exists across the declared hard carriers.
Every declared compressed orientation summary is scalar-inexact on at least one hard carrier. Common exactness appears only at exact orientation provenance / reconstruction-control granularity.

Deterministic cyclic reassignment of orientation annotations preserves scalar exactness for exact orientation provenance on all carriers and can improve several coarser summaries; true orientation labels therefore lack unique scalar explanatory privilege in this experiment.
The same-geometry 6x3 k=3/k=4 comparison has no shared scalar-exact compressed orientation feature vocabulary; the only shared feature key lies in a candidate that fails both.

EW-RS-069 exact pair-delta exchange is scalar-exact across the same hard carriers without explicit orientation provenance and is strictly more compressed on 4x5-k4, making exchange/support structure the stronger common organizing candidate.

exactChannelAnatomy: H is transverse to vertical support chains and has at most one source-line cell per column.
V lies within one support chain and one column advance can affect multiple surviving cells of the same V source line.
D couples column displacement to changing support depth and is mixed geometry/support structure.
dtsDisposition.conclusion: These channel distinctions are exact geometry, but they are not the common source of OOO. Any common DTS law must admit the horizontal-only 6x3-k4 realization; the already exact base-free/non-orientation exchange carrier is therefore the stronger target.
